desk.terminal.look.title: The terminal's look
desk.terminal.look.body: These settings change how the terminal looks. They apply to every open tab right away.

desk.terminal.scrollback.title: Scrollback
desk.terminal.scrollback.body: How many past lines each tab keeps, so that you can scroll back and search them with ⌘F. More lines use more of this Mac's memory.

desk.terminal.copy-on-select.title: Copy on select
desk.terminal.copy-on-select.body: Selecting text in a terminal copies it at once, so you don't need ⌘C.

desk.terminal.option.title: Option key as Meta
desk.terminal.option.body: Meta sends Esc plus the key, for shell shortcuts such as ⌥B and ⌥F, which move a word back and forward. Keep one Option key Normal if your keyboard types @, |, { } or [ ] with Option.

desk.files.hidden.title: Hidden files
desk.files.hidden.body: Shows files and folders whose names start with a dot, such as .bashrc. Most of these are settings, so change them with care.

desk.files.transfers.title: Transfers
desk.files.transfers.body: Shows what's copying, what's waiting and what has finished. A copy keeps going if you close Files. Stop removes what had arrived and changes nothing at the destination.

desk.files.conflict.title: Names already taken
desk.files.conflict.body: Something with this name is already there, so choose what happens to each item. Keep both is the safe choice. Replace, and Merge for files with the same name, remove the old copy once the new one has arrived, and it doesn't go to the Trash.

desk.editor.versions.title: Going back
desk.editor.versions.body: Revert throws away your unsaved changes and reads the file again. To go further back, use Previous versions: SparkBox keeps the last five versions each time you save here.

desk.editor.read-only.title: Why you can't type here
desk.editor.read-only.body: While Admin mode is locked you can read this file but not change it. Click Unlock… to edit it. In look-only mode nothing can be edited.

desk.editor.review.title: Review changes
desk.editor.review.body: Lines marked − are on disk now, and lines marked + are your version. You see this before a save with sudo, and before saving YAML or JSON that doesn't parse.

desk.general.menu-bar.title: Keep running in the menu bar
desk.general.menu-bar.body: On: closing the window keeps SparkBox running in the menu bar, so monitoring, the Server and the VPN keep going. Off: closing the window quits SparkBox.

desk.general.login.title: Start at login
desk.general.login.body: SparkBox starts when you log in to this Mac, with no window, in the menu bar. Changing this asks for Touch ID or your Mac password.

desk.general.upcoming.title: Show upcoming features
desk.general.upcoming.body: Adds a Coming soon group to the sidebar. It lists planned engines that aren't built yet, each with what it will do.

desk.appearance.theme.title: Theme
desk.appearance.theme.body: System follows macOS, choosing Light or Dark. Black is true black with brighter chart and metric colors, for an OLED screen or a dark room.

desk.appearance.motion.title: Reduce motion
desk.appearance.motion.body: On stops pulsing, spinning and sliding. System follows macOS: System Settings › Accessibility › Display.

desk.appearance.contrast.title: Increase contrast
desk.appearance.contrast.body: On gives darker lines, a solid selection and a thicker focus ring. System follows macOS: System Settings › Accessibility › Display.

desk.scenarios.about.title: Demo scenarios
desk.scenarios.about.body: A scenario makes the simulated cluster act out a problem, then recover, so that you can see how SparkBox reports trouble. Only the demo changes, and the VPN stays real. In look-only mode, this page doesn't respond.

ops.updates.continue1025.title: Continue cell2 to kernel 1025
ops.updates.continue1025.body: Review cell2's saved update after healthy 1024 startup, then choose Update cell2 with proposed updates… above the package list. Confirm the exact versions with Admin mode and the node's name. The original checkpoint and recovery kernels stay recorded; restart separately and verify every check.

ops.updates.system.title: Protected system updates
ops.updates.system.body: Review exact updates for one idle node; startup and recovery settings must pass first. The named Update button requires Admin mode and typing the node name. Restart separately and verify every check before another node; completed update history stays available.

ops.howto.library.title: Playbook library
ops.howto.library.body: Read NVIDIA guides offline, follow plain-language steps and keep your own notes. Other hardware and older guides stay marked as references. Source checks run only when you request them.

ops.howto.actions.title: SparkBox actions
ops.howto.actions.body: Check selected nodes or prepare a reviewed image through SparkBox’s existing controls. Image preparation downloads software without launching a workload. Text from NVIDIA or AI cannot add commands to these controls.

ops.howto.ai.title: Reviewed AI drafts
ops.howto.ai.body: Choose the provider and the exact sections to send. The reply is an editable draft. Compare it with your saved text before saving a new local edition; previous editions stay available.
